subject: analysis
source_sentence: The analysis is based on distinctive marker substrings that are extracted from 142 poems using a modified version of Monte-Carlo Feature Finding (a quasi-random search algorithm), which are then ranked according to distinctiveness as measured by χ2 in separating the categories Young Yeats and Old Yeats.
title: A Diachronic Corpus for Literary Style Analysis
